`lambda.fasta` is the complete bacteriophage lambda reference J02459.1, retrieved
from https://www.ebi.ac.uk/ena/browser/api/fasta/J02459.1 on 2026-10-12. Only the
FASTA header was normalized. It is a native positive-control sequence, not a
bacterial-host or functional-targeting assertion. The INSDC public sequence is
used with accession attribution. No service job or deployment output is stored.
